tagline: Global Net Lease, Inc. is an internally managed real estate investment trust focused on acquiring and managing a global portfolio of income-producing net lease assets across the U.S. and Western and Northern Europe.
hero_kpi_rationale: This KPI is the hero because it reflects the operational health of the real estate portfolio and demand for leased spaces. A high occupancy rate (97%) indicates efficient management and strong stability of rental revenues, key drivers of a REIT's performance.

kpis.name: Property Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total number of properties held by the company.
kpis.description: Portfolio size is an indicator of the company's presence and scope in the real estate market.
kpis.signal: Indicates the scale of real estate operations.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leased space actually rented.
kpis.description: A high occupancy rate suggests strong demand, good portfolio management, and revenue stability.
kpis.signal: Indicator of demand for leased space and operational efficiency.

kpis.name: Weighted Average Remaining Lease Term
kpis.explanation: Weighted average duration of remaining lease contracts.
kpis.description: Longer lease terms provide greater stability and visibility of recurring revenues.
kpis.signal: Indicates visibility of future rental revenues and portfolio stability.

kpis.name: Consolidated Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of company debt, including mortgage financing, borrowings, and senior notes.
kpis.description: Debt management is crucial for financial health, operational flexibility, and REIT distribution capacity.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's leverage level and capital structure.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consolidated annual revenue, value extracted from yfinance.income_stmt for the last four reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance for the last four years.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance for the last four years.

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance for the last four years.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leased space actually rented.
kpis.description: An occupancy rate of 97% reflects management excellence and strong demand for the real estate portfolio.
kpis.signal: Indicator of demand for leased space and operational efficiency.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: Interest rate risk is high due to exposure to variable interest rates. A 1% variation in interest rates on unhedged variable-rate debt would result in approximately $480.3 million variation in annual interest expense. Fixed-rate and hedged debt would be affected in fair value by $53.5 million (decrease) or $51.8 million (increase).

risks.title: Currency Exchange Risk
risks.score_rationale: Currency risk exists due to foreign investments, notably in Europe (26% of annualized rental revenue as of December 31, 2025), the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, Finland, and Germany, as well as Canada. The company is exposed to fluctuations in EUR, GBP, and CAD exchange rates.

risks.title: Credit Risk Concentration
risks.score_rationale: Credit risk concentration is high due to sector concentrations: 46% Industrial Distribution, 27% Retail, 27% Office. Although no tenant exceeds 10% of annualized rental revenue, geographic and sector concentrations could result in payment defaults in case of economic difficulties.

risks.title: Refinancing Risk
risks.score_rationale: Refinancing risk is high due to the need to refinance mortgage loans at maturity, notably in Europe with future principal payments ($99.9 million projected for foreign mortgages from 2026 onwards). The ability to refinance at favorable terms depends on capital markets conditions.

ai_positioning.summary: GNL has no significant mentions regarding artificial intelligence or machine learning in the provided 10-K/20-F document excerpts.
